requirements.description: Original 10-K passages identifying Microsoft's reportable segments for FY2025 (Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, More Personal Computing), including the segment note and Business section, with necessary qualifications.

Complete enumeration in the FY2025 10-K of the principal products, services and activities included in each reportable segment (e.g. Microsoft 365, LinkedIn, Dynamics; Azure, server products, Enterprise and partner services; Windows, Devices, Gaming, Search and news advertising), preserving qualifiers and affiliations.
